sentences.en: Instantly the girl saw her mother, she burst out crying.
sentences.zh: 那个女孩一看到她的母亲就立刻哭了起来。

sentences.en: "You can know anything instantly ... if you Google it." "Google?"
sentences.zh: "你可以通过Google立即知道任何事情……","Google?"

sentences.en: He was hit by a falling rock and died instantly.
sentences.zh: 他被一块落下的石头击中，当场死亡。
